body.message:
I am currently sourcing for an apartment for a nine-month stay, starting September 19.

It has to be close to Dubai Media City, so we would prefer a property in or near Al Sufouh, Dubai Marina, JBR, JLT, or another area with convenient Metro access to Media City.

Could you please share your available studio and one-bedroom options, including:

Price
Details of all taxes, fees, and utilities
Wi-Fi, parking, and other inclusions
Deposit and payment terms
Cancellation and early-termination policies
Distance to the nearest Metro or tram station
